assumptions.statement: Repository provisional polygons are used only as a coherent temporary model.
assumptions.impact: Every precision-sensitive geometry and metric must be recalculated.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official cleared SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, heritage controls and municipal capacities remain unknown.
assumptions.impact: No parcel demolition, statutory zoning, engineering line or approval claim is made.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Approved regulatory and specialist-control data become available.

assumptions.statement: A Living Manual page is a temporary service record, not a new statutory decision channel.
assumptions.impact: Every pilot requires a named accountable owner, paid editor, field verifier and action/referral owner.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A local host and service-specific operating agreement are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: The pilot can function without default audio/video, continuous location, facial recognition or a personal history profile.
assumptions.impact: The public ledger contains redacted structured summaries, not raw personal stories.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A lawful data inventory, retention schedule, withdrawal workflow and privacy review are approved.

assumptions.statement: Six personas and three opening scenes are synthetic design probes, not interviews or proof of public support.
assumptions.impact: No claim of representativeness is made; future participant seats require transparent recruitment and paid participation.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A documented recruitment, compensation and inclusion process is completed.

assumptions.statement: Response times must be risk-tiered and capacity-tested rather than fixed at 3/14/30 days.
assumptions.impact: Queues, urgent referrals, response targets and closures are set only by the named owner before launch.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: The owner publishes service classes, escalation routes, staff hours and maximum queue.

assumptions.statement: The railway is a narrative binding line; exact heritage protection and construction-control boundaries are not inferred.
assumptions.impact: All nearby physical actions stay lightweight, reversible and subject to specialist review.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official heritage boundaries and conservation requirements are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Frontline and targeted co-design participation is paid work, not free data extraction.
assumptions.impact: Targeted recruitment does not start without budget, workload limits, credit/licensing choice and a complaints route.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A budget holder and compensation schedule are approved.

assumptions.statement: Beiwei Community, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, Beijing E-Town and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei are taskbook-named interfaces only; no cooperation, capability, counterpart, data access, site or budget is verified.
assumptions.impact: Regional links remain invitation interfaces with a valid decline path; the package makes no partnership, co-building, investment, delivery or impact claim.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A public source, counterpart confirmation, named responsibility, lawful data boundary and scoped exchange record exist for a specific interface.
